name: AI Video Studio
description: An AI-powered YouTube content studio for planning stories, reviewing storyboards and narration, generating synthetic speech, and rendering downloadable videos locally. Estimate-first approvals make generation plans and resource needs visible so users can control quality and cost tradeoffs; estimates are not provider quotes or actual invoice totals. Also produced video generator builder, a reusable AI agent skill available for purchase on Agensi.

relatedLinks.label: video generator builder (Agensi)
relatedLinks.description: A commercially available AI agent skill derived from AI Video Studio. Provides an engineering workflow for building video generators with cost controls, staged approvals, provider abstraction, durable media state, and validation.

name: Casa Perla
description: A bilingual vacation-rental website for a home in Punta Uva, Costa Rica. Brings property details, a photo gallery, local context, availability inquiries, and booking and contact links into a guest-facing experience. The site is publicly available; its source repository is private.

name: AI Trip Planner
description: A Streamlit itinerary planner using OpenAI tool calling, verified place data, optional travel-guide retrieval, interactive maps, and PDF or JSON export. Optional model and place services can fail independently of itinerary planning.

name: IntakeWise
description: A responsive organizer for medication, supplements, vitamins, and custom intake schedules. Account holders can manage a private item catalog, review schedules in a calendar, and adjust or skip individual intakes.

name: Nomadant Tech Store
description: An academic full-stack electronics storefront with GitHub OAuth sign-in and Stripe test-mode checkout. Its React storefront and Node.js REST API are deployed separately.

name: AI Engineering Lessons
description: Selected for XERJ Corpus Hub as a public code-reference corpus for AI coding agents, with its banking-classification capstone using MLP and RoBERTa with PII protections highlighted as selected work. The collection covers AI, machine learning, and RAG. Its historical Azure Search and OpenAI sample is archived; the repository states that the model service has been retired.

relatedLinks.label: XERJ Corpus Hub selection
relatedLinks.description: XERJ Corpus Hub lists AI Engineering Lessons as a public, attributed code-reference corpus for AI coding agents and highlights the banking-classification capstone using MLP and RoBERTa with PII protections. The corpus covers the whole repository at a pinned commit. Inclusion establishes code-reference indexing, not evidence that a model was trained on this work.

name: Full Stack Engineering Lessons
description: Coursework and projects spanning frontend, backend, APIs, databases, authentication, testing, and Git. The repository includes RESTful Restaurants and an e-commerce REST API.

name: RESTful Restaurants
description: A responsive application for organizing restaurants into categories, maintaining a starred list, and managing records through an Express API backed by Supabase.

name: Tutare
description: A bilingual portfolio for creative workshops and event services, with facilitator profiles and an artwork gallery. Spanish is the default language, with English available throughout the site.

name: Python Lessons
description: Python exercises, university assignments, data-analysis notebooks, and personal learning projects, including an interactive multimodal commute-map project.

name: Unbound Root
description: A static, multilingual educational website about cyberspace, digital safety and cybersecurity awareness for families and everyday internet users.

name: HusKey Manager Security Coursework
description: A UW course repository centered on learning to identify and remediate security issues in a sample password-manager application.
